classes.purpose: Static table mapping abnormal-status (debuff) flags to priority values. Used to resolve which abnormal state takes precedence when several are active.

methods.purpose: Return CInfoManager<CAbnormalStatePriorityInfo>* (find-or-default); returns static empty instance &DAT_12393650 if not loaded.

Given an abnormal-state bitmask (param_1) and level offset (param_2), iterate bits 1..0x14 (20 states); for each set bit look up its row by bit-index and, if row+0x14 set, fold into *param_3 (priorityA via max FUN_117cbae0), if row+0x18 set fold into *param_4 (priorityB). Clamps result 0x13 to param_2+0x13.

fields.name: hasPriorityGroupA
fields.note: if nonzero, this abnormal state contributes to priority output A

fields.name: hasPriorityGroupB
fields.note: if nonzero, contributes to priority output B

formulas: Iterates 20 abnormal-state bits (index 1..0x14). If a level offset param_2>0 the state mask is OR'd with 0x80000. Result priority 0x13 (19) is remapped to param_2+0x13.
Priority accumulation uses FUN_117cbae0(current, bitIndex) = max/select.

classes.purpose: Static config for guild-building level-up rules (per building type, its level rows). Used to query the max level available for a building type.

Raw singleton manager pointer accessor (returns *DAT when arg 0).

fields.name: level

classes.purpose: Static config for monster rage/enrage states. The recovered method walks a red-black tree of active entities and toggles a rage flag when a matching rage entry is found.

methods.purpose: Walk a std::map/rbtree at this+0xb (nodes) after validating an entity chain (this+5 -> +0x10 -> +0x1c -> +0x2af4); for each node compare its key (node+4) against a resolved id and, if a matching rage row exists in the manager, invoke vtbl+8(1) (set rage active).

classes.notes: Row field layout not exposed; only manager count/array access. FUN_11719490/117194b0/11518b30/1141ca30 resolve/compare an entity id.

classes.purpose: Static faction definition table. Builds the faction-vs-faction relationship matrix for 10 factions at init.

methods.purpose: For each faction i in 1..10 first reset via vtbl+0x14(i); then look up faction i's row and for each j in i..10 compute relation FUN_1184aa80(j) and store via vtbl+0x18(i,j,value). Builds the 10x10 faction relation matrix.

classes.purpose: Static table for X-Hunter (special hunter mode) value scaling by level. Given a level and category it interpolates a value from a level-band row.

methods.purpose: Iterate rows; find the row whose category (row+0x10 / 100) == param_2 and whose level band [row+0x14, row+0x18] contains param_1 (level). Interpolate a value across the band.

fields.name: categoryPacked
fields.note: row+0x10/100 is the category matched against param_2

formulas: value = ((level - levelMin) / levelStep) * valuePerStep + valueBase, when valuePerStep != 0; otherwise value = valueBase.

classes.purpose: Static experience-limit table (per-level exp caps). Works together with CPlayerLevelUpInfo to compute how many levels an exp gain crosses given the exp cap rows.

methods.purpose: Given a start level (param_1), current exp (param_2) and exp-to-add (param_3), read the exp-limit row (row+0x14 = per-level exp cap) via keyed lookup, then loop applying caps (using CPlayerLevelUpInfo row+0x30/max-level at +0xd0) to count how many levels are gained; returns level count or -1 on error.

classes.notes: FUN_1046c7c0(1)+0xd0 = server max level; FUN_1139dcb0 advances level/exp given a cap.
